import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source CSV files
source_files = {
    "hispanic": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/training_0.csv",
    "mixed": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/training_1.csv",
    "other": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/training_2.csv",
    "asian": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/training_3.csv",
    "whites": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/training_4.csv",
    "aian": "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/training_5.csv",
}

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df_hispanic = pd.read_csv(source_files["hispanic"], index_col=0)
df_mixed = pd.read_csv(source_files["mixed"], index_col=0)
df_other = pd.read_csv(source_files["other"], index_col=0)
df_asian = pd.read_csv(source_files["asian"], index_col=0)
df_whites = pd.read_csv(source_files["whites"], index_col=0)
df_aian = pd.read_csv(source_files["aian"], index_col=0)

# We have 6 source tables, each with schema:
# ['CountyID', 'CountyName', <population_column>, 'Year', 'ID']
# The target table schema has all these population columns as separate columns,
# with repeated CountyID and CountyName columns suffixed with _x, _y, _x_9, etc.
# The pattern suggests joining all source tables on ['CountyID', 'CountyName', 'Year', 'ID'] keys,
# then renaming columns to match the target schema.

# Define the join keys (all four columns are present in all sources)
join_keys = ['CountyID', 'CountyName', 'Year', 'ID']

# Start joining from df_whites as base (arbitrary choice)
df = df_whites.copy()

# Rename whites_population columns to target suffixes
df = df.rename(columns={
    'CountyID': 'CountyID_x',
    'CountyName': 'CountyName_x',
    'whites_population': 'whites_population',
    'Year': 'Year_x',
    'ID': 'ID'
})

# Join with df_other (other_population)
df_other_renamed = df_other.rename(columns={
    'CountyID': 'CountyID_y',
    'CountyName': 'CountyName_y',
    'other_population': 'other_population',
    'Year': 'Year_y',
    'ID': 'ID'
})
df = pd.merge(df, df_other_renamed, how='inner',
              left_on=['ID'], right_on=['ID'],
              suffixes=('', '_other'))

# Join with df_mixed (mixed_population)
df_mixed_renamed = df_mixed.rename(columns={
    'CountyID': 'CountyID_x_9',
    'CountyName': 'CountyName_x_10',
    'mixed_population': 'mixed_population',
    'Year': 'Year_x_12',
    'ID': 'ID'
})
df = pd.merge(df, df_mixed_renamed, how='inner',
              left_on=['ID'], right_on=['ID'],
              suffixes=('', '_mixed'))

# Join with df_hispanic (hispanic_population)
df_hispanic_renamed = df_hispanic.rename(columns={
    'CountyID': 'CountyID_y_13',
    'CountyName': 'CountyName_y_14',
    'hispanic_population': 'hispanic_population',
    'Year': 'Year_y_16',
    'ID': 'ID'
})
df = pd.merge(df, df_hispanic_renamed, how='inner',
              left_on=['ID'], right_on=['ID'],
              suffixes=('', '_hispanic'))

# Join with df_asian (asian_population)
df_asian_renamed = df_asian.rename(columns={
    'CountyID': 'CountyID_x_17',
    'CountyName': 'CountyName_x_18',
    'asian_population': 'asian_population',
    'Year': 'Year_x_20',
    'ID': 'ID'
})
df = pd.merge(df, df_asian_renamed, how='inner',
              left_on=['ID'], right_on=['ID'],
              suffixes=('', '_asian'))

# Join with df_aian (aian_population)
df_aian_renamed = df_aian.rename(columns={
    'CountyID': 'CountyID_y_21',
    'CountyName': 'CountyName_y_22',
    'aian_population': 'aian_population',
    'Year': 'Year_y_24',
    'ID': 'ID'
})
df = pd.merge(df, df_aian_renamed, how='inner',
              left_on=['ID'], right_on=['ID'],
              suffixes=('', '_aian'))

# After all joins, select and reorder columns exactly as target schema:
target_columns = [
    'CountyID_x', 'CountyName_x', 'whites_population', 'Year_x', 'ID',
    'CountyID_y', 'CountyName_y', 'other_population', 'Year_y',
    'CountyID_x_9', 'CountyName_x_10', 'mixed_population', 'Year_x_12',
    'CountyID_y_13', 'CountyName_y_14', 'hispanic_population', 'Year_y_16',
    'CountyID_x_17', 'CountyName_x_18', 'asian_population', 'Year_x_20',
    'CountyID_y_21', 'CountyName_y_22', 'aian_population', 'Year_y_24'
]

# Check if all target columns exist in df, if not raise error
missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after join: {missing_cols}")

df_target = df[target_columns]

# Save the final dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_27/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
